steps.do: Greet the customer politely. Identity verification is not needed, because no customer records are looked up or changed and the customer submits the application themselves. Verify only if the lookup_user branch below is triggered.
steps.quote: You should ONLY verify a user's identity if you need to access or modify their customer information in internal databases on their behalf.

steps.do: Confirm the customer wants a new business credit card that gives the most money back on one large purchase. Ask for purchase_amount, purchase_type, business_type and existing_rho_bank_credit_cards if they have not said them. Identity verification is not needed for a recommendation because no records are looked up. Verify (2 of DOB, email, phone, address, then log_verification) only if you must open the customer's records.
steps.quote: Every Rho-Bank credit card earns rewards on all purchases, but certain categories of spending may earn you bonus rewards at a higher rate.

steps.do: Ask for whichever of these the customer has not given: the purchase amount, the billing merchant, what is being bought (its category) and the type of business. Ask only for missing facts.
steps.quote: Purchases in non-bonus categories earn the card’s default rate.

steps.do: Ask whether the customer already holds any Rho-Bank credit cards. Promos and fee waivers are for new customers only.
steps.if: the customer has not already said whether they hold Rho-Bank credit cards
steps.quote: Offer is for new customers only and applies to new accounts opened within the promotion window.

steps.do: Look up the customer's record by the name they gave. If they gave an email, use get_user_information_by_email. If they gave a user id, use get_user_information_by_id.
steps.if: the customer says they already hold Rho-Bank credit cards and is unsure which, so their accounts must be read to judge new-customer promo eligibility
steps.quote: To verify the identity of the user, call the appropriate read tools, and ensure that they are able to give correctly any 2 out of the following values: date of birth, email, phone number, address.

steps.do: Check that 2 of the values the customer gave (date of birth, email, phone, address) match the record from lookup_user. Reveal nothing from the record until they match. If they never match, do not read any accounts. Give the recommendation with new-customer promos marked as subject to eligibility.
steps.quote: Knowing full name or userID is not enough to verify.

steps.do: Get the current date. Use it for every promo-window check and for the verification log. Never assume the date.
steps.quote: This offer is available from 2025-10-01 through 2026-03-31.

steps.do: Log the verification record.
steps.quote: After verification, you must call the verification logging tool to properly log the information into the verification records.

steps.do: Read the customer's credit card accounts. If the customer already holds a card type, that card's new-customer promo or fee waiver does not apply.
steps.quote: Open your account within the promotional window and meet new customer eligibility criteria

steps.do: Decide which reward category the purchase falls in for each card. Remember that each card has its own bonus categories. Categories: Travel, Software (subscriptions, licenses, cloud), Media (advertising, streaming), Green/Sustainable, Operations, Transportation (logistics, shipping, rideshare), or Other. A vehicle purchase is not listed as travel, software, media, operations or sustainable, so it earns each card's default rate unless a document says otherwise.
steps.quote: Each credit card has its own bonus categories with higher reward rates.

steps.do: Business Bronze Rewards Card: purchase × 1.0%. Add a $500 statement credit if today (get_time) is within 2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31 and net purchases reach $10,000 within 2 months. Annual fee is $0.00.
steps.quote: Make net new purchases totaling $10,000 within the first 2 months of account opening.

steps.do: Business Silver Rewards Card: purchase × 1.0% (non travel/software), doubled only if the account opens within 2024-11-14 to 2025-11-14. Annual fee is $122.50, or 0 in the first year if the account opens within 2025-11-15 to 2026-01-15.
steps.quote: New Business Silver Rewards Card customers can earn 2x cash back on all purchases for the first 6 months after opening their account.

steps.do: Business Silver Rewards Card: software and travel earn 10.0%, other purchases 1.0%. Merchants on the exclusion list, including Apple, Microsoft and Dell, earn only 1.0%. The 2x promo counts only for accounts opened 2024-11-14 to 2025-11-14.
steps.quote: The following specific merchants do NOT earn the 10.0% bonus rate and instead earn the standard 1.0% rate:

steps.do: Business Gold Rewards Card: purchase × 1.0% (a vehicle is not listed as operations spend), or 2.5% if the purchase is operations spend. Annual fee is $200.00.
steps.quote: Purchases that do not qualify as operations spend earn cash back at 1.0%.

steps.do: Business Platinum Rewards Card: purchase × 1.5% (non travel/software/media). Annual fee is $450.00, or 0 in the first year if the account opens within 2025-11-01 to 2026-02-28.
steps.quote: Purchases outside those categories earn 1.5%.

steps.do: Business Platinum Rewards Card: travel, software and media earn 4.0%, everything else 1.5%. A streaming or software subscription counts as software or media. No merchant exclusion list applies. The credit limit can reach $400,000.
steps.quote: Travel, software, and media advertising purchases earn 4.0%.

steps.do: Green Rewards Card: purchase × 1.0% (not a sustainable merchant), or 3.0% at a qualifying sustainable merchant. Annual fee is $100.00.
steps.quote: Purchases at qualifying sustainable merchants earn 3.0%, while all other eligible purchases earn 1.0%.

steps.do: Silver Zoom Card: purchase × 1.0%, or 3.0% for transportation/logistics. Multiply by 3 only if today is still within the triple promo claim window (2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31). Annual fee is $74.50. Consider this card only if the customer's business is a transportation/logistics operator.
steps.quote: All other eligible purchases earn 3 × 1.0% during the promo period

steps.do: Rate the other business cards. Gold: 2.5% on operations, 1.0% otherwise, $200 fee. Bronze: 1.0% plus a $500 credit for $10,000 spent in 2 months (offer runs 2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31), but its credit line tops out at $50,000. Green: 3.0% only at sustainable merchants, credit line up to $75,000. Silver Zoom: logistics card, 3x promo only if claimed by 2025-12-31.
steps.quote: Spend $10,000 in the first 2 months to receive a $500 statement credit.

steps.do: Drop any card whose documented maximum credit line is below the purchase amount: the purchase could not fit on it. Maximum lines: Business Bronze $50,000; Green Rewards $75,000; Business Silver $112,500; Silver Zoom $175,000; Business Gold $225,000; Business Platinum $400,000. Tell the customer the actual limit is set by underwriting.
steps.quote: Keep spending within your assigned credit limit and monitor available credit before initiating large transactions.

steps.do:
For each card left after check_credit_line:
1. Cash back = purchase_amount × rate, rounded down to whole points (1 point = $0.01).
2. Add any promo the customer qualifies for on today's date.
3. Pick exactly one card, the one with the highest total.
4. State the breakdown: cash back + promo = total. Mention the annual fee separately.
For a software or streaming purchase from an Apple-type merchant, this is the Business Platinum Rewards Card at 4.0%. For a purchase in no bonus category, while its window is open, Business Bronze (1.0% plus the $500 credit) beats Business Platinum (1.5%) when the purchase is under $100,000 and at or below Bronze's $50,000 line.
steps.quote: All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number.

steps.do: Present the single card from compute_and_recommend, even if the customer asks about several. State its cash back, its promo amount, the total and the annual fee. Give the promo conditions, for example that the $10,000 in net spend must post within 2 months and that returns reduce it. Say that approval and the credit line come from underwriting. Give the card's minimum personal credit score: Bronze 660, Green 690, Silver 700, Gold 735, Platinum 765, Silver Zoom 680.
steps.quote: All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number.

steps.do: Explain the Business Platinum annual fee: $0 for the first year if the account is opened 2025-11-01 to 2026-02-28, otherwise $450.00.
steps.if: the recommended card is the Business Platinum Rewards Card
steps.quote: After the first year, the standard annual fee applies: $450.00

steps.do: Tell the customer the triple cash back is not automatic: they must claim it in the account portal under promotional offers, within the claim window.
steps.if: the recommended card is the Silver Zoom Card and its triple promo was counted
steps.quote: Select the triple cash back offer and confirm your acceptance within the claim window

steps.do: Confirm that the customer understands the total return. Tell them any condition, such as meeting the promo spend within the window or claiming a promo in the portal.
steps.if: customer asks to confirm the expected return
steps.quote: Plan larger purchases early in the period so they post within 2 months.

steps.do: Before the customer applies, ask for any of these they have not given: full name, annual income, and whether they have a Rho-Bank+ subscription. Restate the recommended card's exact name.
steps.if: the customer wants to apply and has not given all three application details
steps.quote: Complete the online application with your legal name, address, and Social Security number.

steps.do: The customer applies for the recommended card with their own apply_for_credit_card tool. The agent does not apply for them.

args.card_type: the recommended card's exact name, e.g. 'Business Bronze Rewards Card' or 'Business Platinum Rewards Card'

steps.quote: Review and submit your application.

steps.do: Confirm the application result. If approved, remind the customer of the promo conditions. If it was declined or returned an error, explain the stated reason. Do not apply for another card unless the customer asks.
steps.quote: Only net purchases count; returns or credits reduce your qualifying total.

steps.do: If the application fails in a way no document covers, or the customer insists on a human, explain what you can and cannot do. Ask whether they want a transfer, and call transfer_to_human_agents only if they say yes.

args.summary: the recommendation given and what failed
args.reason: the error or the customer's request

steps.if: the issue cannot be resolved with the documents and the customer agrees to a transfer
steps.quote: If they do, invoke the appropriate transfer_to_human_agents tool.

jobs.done_when:
All of the following are true:
- The agent has recommended exactly one business card, and the purchase fits within that card's documented credit line.
- The agent gave a dollar breakdown of the return (cash back + any promo = total), the promo conditions, and the annual fee stated separately.
- Promo windows were checked against get_current_time.
- If records were read, the customer was verified and the verification was logged.
- The customer has applied for that card with apply_for_credit_card and the result was explained, or the customer declined.

open_questions: No internal document gives a procedure for recommending a business card. The comparison (cash back + promo, with the fee stated separately) is put together from the product pages.
No document assigns a vehicle purchase to a bonus category. It is treated as earning the default rate.

Silver Zoom is 'built for' transportation/logistics operators. It is unclear whether other businesses, such as a landscaping fleet, are ineligible or only a poor fit. While its triple promo claim window is open, 3 × 1.0% would beat Bronze's 1.0% + $500 on large purchases.
The documents do not say whether to rank cards net of the first-year annual fee. The library states the fee separately.
No document says whether 'new customer' means new to Rho-Bank or new to that card product.
No document covers what to do if apply_for_credit_card is declined.

steps.do: For each candidate business card, compute the first-year return on the purchase. Cash back = amount × the card's rate for the purchase's category, multiplied by any active cash back promo multiplier, with points floored at 1 point = $0.01. Add any active statement-credit promo whose spend threshold the purchase meets within its time limit. Subtract the first-year annual fee unless an active waiver applies. Candidates: Business Bronze (1.0%, $0 fee, $500 credit after $10,000 net purchases in 2 months); Business Silver (10.0% travel/software, 1.0% other, $122.50 fee); Business Gold (2.5% operations, 1.0% other, $200.00 fee); Business Platinum (4.0% travel/software/media advertising, 1.5% other, $450.00 fee); Green Rewards (3.0% sustainable merchants, 1.0% other, $100.00 fee); Silver Zoom (3.0% sector-specific, 1.0% other, $74.50 fee). Include Silver Zoom only if the business is a transportation/logistics operator. Also check that the purchase fits within each card's credit-limit range.
steps.quote: Consider your net rewards after the $200.00 annual fee when planning large purchases.

steps.do: Recommend exactly one card: the one with the highest computed total. State the cash back amount, any promo amount, any annual fee, and the total. State the promo conditions, such as the purchase must post within the promo's time limit and approval and the credit limit come from underwriting. State the card's minimum credit score and PAYDEX requirements. Do not give internal reasoning beyond the customer-facing terms. If the customer asks for one choice among several cards, give the single best one.
steps.quote: Spend $10,000 in the first 2 months to receive a $500 statement credit.

steps.do: Before the customer applies, ask for the details they have not given: full name, annual income, and whether they have a Rho-Bank+ subscription. Restate the recommended card's exact name.
steps.if: the customer wants to apply for the recommended card
steps.quote: Complete the online application with your legal name, address, and Social Security number.

steps.do: The customer runs apply_for_credit_card with the recommended card's exact name (for example 'Business Bronze Rewards Card'), their full name, their annual income, and their Rho-Bank+ subscription status. The agent does not apply for them.
steps.quote: Review and submit your application.

steps.do: Confirm the application result. If approved, remind the customer of the promo conditions, for example that the qualifying spend must post within the promo's time limit and that returns reduce qualifying spend. If the application failed or returned an error, explain the stated reason. Do not resubmit or apply for a different card unless the customer asks. If nothing resolves it, ask whether they want a human agent.
steps.quote: Only net purchases count; returns or credits reduce your qualifying total.
